text_en: I also am mortal, like everyone else, a descendant of the first-formed child of earth; and in the womb of a mother I was molded into flesh,
text_cn: 我也是有死的人，同众人一样；我也是出于用土受造的原祖，在母胎中形成了肉躯，

text_en: within the period of ten months, compacted with blood, from the seed of a man and the pleasure of marriage.
text_cn: 十月之久，在母血中凝结，由男精与合梦的欲乐而形成。

text_en: And when I was born, I began to breathe the common air, and fell upon the kindred earth; my first sound was a cry, as is true of all.
text_cn: 我一出生，便呼吸了公共的空气，落在具有同一命运的地上，哭出了第一声，与众人无异；

text_en: I was nursed with care in swaddling cloths.
text_cn: 我在襁褓中，受了母亲的抚育和照顾。

text_en: For no king has had a different beginning of existence;
text_cn: 没有一位君王，另有不同的诞生，

text_en: there is for all one entrance into life, and one way out.
text_cn: 因为，人人进入生命的路，只有一条，去世亦然。

text_en: Therefore I prayed, and understanding was given me; I called on God, and the spirit of wisdom came to me.
text_cn: 为此，我曾祈求，天主就赐给了我聪明；我曾呼吁，智慧的神便临于我身。

text_en: I preferred her to scepters and thrones, and I accounted wealth as nothing in comparison with her.
text_cn: 我宁要智慧，而不要王权和王位；财富与她相较，分文不值。

text_en: Neither did I liken to her any priceless gem, because all gold is but a little sand in her sight, and silver will be accounted as clay before her.
text_cn: 无价的宝石也不能与她相比，因为，一切黄金在她面前，不过只是一粒细沙；白银在她跟前，无异一撮(cuō)泥土。

text_en: I loved her more than health and beauty, and I chose to have her rather than light, because her radiance never ceases.
text_cn: 我爱她，胜过爱健康和美色，我以她比光明更为可取，因为，由她而来的光辉，从不暗淡。

text_en: All good things came to me along with her, and in her hands uncounted wealth.
text_cn: 的确，一切美物都伴她而来，在她手中握有数不清的财富。

text_en: I rejoiced in them all, because wisdom leads them; but I did not know that she was their mother.
text_cn: 为了这一切美物，我极其欢乐，因为，智慧是一切美物的先导；我一向还不知道，智慧竟是一切美物的母亲。

text_en: I learned without guile and I impart without grudging; I do not hide her wealth,
text_cn: 我诚心地学习了，我也豪爽地分施与人，我绝不隐藏智慧的财富。

text_en: for it is an unfailing treasure for mortals; those who get it obtain friendship with God, commended for the gifts that come from instruction.
text_cn: 因为智慧是人用之不尽的宝藏；凡占有的人，必获得天主的友爱，赖受教而获得的恩赐，深得天主的欢心。

text_en: May God grant me to speak with judgment, and to have thoughts worthy of what I have received; for he is the guide even of wisdom and the corrector of the wise.
text_cn: 愿天主使我遵照他的意愿说话，使我的思想配合他的恩赐，因为是他领导智慧，引导智者；

text_en: For both we and our words are in his hand, as are all understanding and skill in crafts.
text_cn: 原来，我们和我们的言论，我们的一切聪明和技巧，都在他手中。

text_en: For it is he who gave me unerring knowledge of what exists, to know the structure of the world and the activity of the elements;
text_cn: 是他把所有事物的正确知识赐给了我，使我明了世界的构造，和元素的能量，

text_en: the beginning and end and middle of times, the alternations of the solstices and the changes of the seasons,
text_cn: 时间的始末和中心，冬至夏至的转变，和季节的变更，

text_en: the cycles of the year and the constellations of the stars,
text_cn: 年岁的循环与星辰的位置，

text_en: the natures of animals and the tempers of wild animals, the powers of spirits and the thoughts of human beings, the varieties of plants and the virtues of roots;
text_cn: 生物的天性，和野兽的本能，鬼神的力量，和人类的思想，植物的繁杂，和草根的效能。

text_en: I learned both what is secret and what is manifest,
text_cn: 所有或隐或明的事，我都知道，因为教导我的，是造万物的技师──智慧。

text_en: for wisdom, the fashioner of all things, taught me. There is in her a spirit that is intelligent, holy, unique, manifold, subtle, mobile, clear, unpolluted, distinct, invulnerable, loving the good, keen, irresistible,
text_cn: 在她内的神，原是聪明的，至圣的，唯一的，多样的，微妙的，敏捷的，精明的，无玷的，率直的，不受损害的，好善的，锐敏的，

text_en: beneficent, humane, steadfast, sure, free from anxiety, all-powerful, overseeing all, and penetrating through all spirits that are intelligent, pure, and altogether subtle.
text_cn: 无敌的，施惠的，爱人的，稳固的，坚决的，无虑的，无所不能的，无所不察的，又是洞察所有明达、洁净和精微心灵的。

text_en: For wisdom is more mobile than any motion; because of her pureness she pervades and penetrates all things.
text_cn: 实在，智慧比一切活动更为活动；她是如此精纯，能渗透深入一切。

text_en: For she is a breath of the power of God, and a pure emanation of the glory of the Almighty; therefore nothing defiled gains entrance into her.
text_cn: 她是天主威能的气息，是全能者荣耀的真诚流露；因此，任何污秽都不能浸入她内。

text_en: For she is a reflection of eternal light, a spotless mirror of the working of God, and an image of his goodness.
text_cn: 她是永远光明的反映，是天主德能的明镜，是天主美善的肖像。

text_en: Although she is but one, she can do all things, and while remaining in herself, she renews all things; in every generation she passes into holy souls and makes them friends of God, and prophets;
text_cn: 她虽是独一的，却无所不能；她虽恒存不变，却常使万物更新。她世世代代，进入圣善的灵魂，使他们成为天主的朋友和先知；

text_en: for God loves nothing so much as the person who lives with wisdom.
text_cn: 因为，天主只爱那与智慧同居共处的人。

text_en: She is more beautiful than the sun, and excels every constellation of the stars. Compared with the light she is found to be superior,
text_cn: 实在，智慧比太阳还美丽，压倒一切星座；如与光明相比，她必占优势；

text_en: for it is succeeded by the night, but against wisdom evil does not prevail.
text_cn: 因为，光明还要让位于黑夜，但是邪恶绝不能战胜智慧。
